scope: Read-only Reviews redesign consultation through Cursor CLI; local implementation decisions recorded separately.
public_plan_source: createPlanToolCall.args.plan; summarized in reviews-overhaul-brief.md. Private reasoning is not published.
evidence_limit: Consultation used prior labeled preview captures and source inspection. Its layout budgets were calculated suggestions, not browser measurements. The current before screenshot arrived after its initial lookup.
accepted: Shape A: compact inbox followed by a full-width review desk with stable review routes.
Separate Preview, Changes, and Evidence modes; remove the persistent queue and Split view.
Recoverable per-review feedback drafts and persisted local decisions.
Exact revision-bound evidence, explicit stale and missing states, and source validation at confirmation.
owner_decisions: Keep inbox compact with status filter, search, and rows rather than six metadata columns.
Readable-width screenshot uses vertical scrolling; 100% means native source pixels with internal panning, not inferred 3x device-point scaling.
Previous and Next traverse all known reviews; do not automatically skip or advance after a decision.
Use only existing labeled screenshot sources; do not invent before imagery or a live preview.

A merge simulation requires Ready state, unchanged pinned source, a succeeded latest task attempt, and all well-formed current checks passing. Optional missing imagery alone does not block text-only review.
Keep all review actions browser-local; no GitHub call, provider dispatch, or repository mutation.
